name: InvenTree
description: Open-source inventory management for parts, stock, suppliers, and BOMs, with a web UI and REST API. Installs the official InvenTree apt package on Debian 13 (nginx, port 80).

notes.text: Admin password is generated at install, shown once, and saved to /etc/inventree/credentials.txt (0600); a package-generated fallback is /etc/inventree/admin_password.txt.
Web UI: http://<container-ip> (nginx 80 to gunicorn:6000). Nginx config: /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/inventree.conf, HTTP only; terminate TLS externally.
Requires Debian 13 (trixie); upstream supports Debian 13 and Ubuntu 24.04/26.04 only, so there is no Alpine path. var_version below 13 aborts.
Data: SQLite at /opt/inventree/data/database.sqlite3; media, static, backups under /opt/inventree/data. For PostgreSQL set INVENTREE_DB_NAME/USER/PASSWORD/HOST/PORT before install.
Site URL: `var_site_url` at install or `inventree config:set INVENTREE_SITE_URL=https://...`. Services: inventree-web, inventree-worker, nginx; logs with `inventree logs`.
Update: `update` in the LXC or `pct exec <CTID> -- update`. Unattended: `var_admin_user`, `var_admin_email`, `var_admin_password`, `var_site_url`.
